name: Airy Clean
description: Airy clean: soft single tube, bright-cap high shelf, open cab 9 kHz — airy, not mid-crush.
script:
# Airy Clean
# Airy clean: soft single tube, bright-cap high shelf, open cab 9 kHz — airy, not mid-crush.

param a = Drive [0.5, 2.8]
param b = Bright [0.0, 7.0]
param c = Level [0.55, 1.45]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 45; resonance = 0.22
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.5)
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 4800; q = 0.65; gain = b
stage2: y = softclip(y, 0.75) * c
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9500; resonance = 0.25

name: Plexi Crunch
description: Plexi bark: dual tube, 750 Hz mid peak (not a bandpass), presence shelf, 5.5 kHz cab.
script:
# Plexi Crunch
# Plexi bark: dual tube, 750 Hz mid peak (not a bandpass), presence shelf, 5.5 kHz cab.

param a = Drive [1.4, 7.5]
param b = Presence [2000, 7000]
param c = Level [0.38, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.38
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.6)
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.7)
eq1: type = peak; freq = 750; q = 1.05; gain = 5
stage3: y = softclip(y * 1.2, 1.45) * c
eq2: type = highshelf; freq = b; q = 0.7; gain = 2.8
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 5500; resonance = 0.4

name: Mesa High Gain
description: Rectifier wall: tight HPF, triple tube, hard soft-knee ceiling, dark cab — densest amp.
script:
# Mesa High Gain
# Rectifier wall: tight HPF, triple tube, hard soft-knee ceiling, dark cab — densest amp.

param a = Gain [3.5, 12.0]
param b = Tight [45, 200]
param c = Level [0.25, 0.9]
gate1: threshold = -46; hyst = 6; hold = 0.03; range = -80
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.6
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.5)
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.6)
stage3: y = tube(y, a * 0.45)
stage4: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.55), 0.68)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4500; resonance = 0.58
stage5: y = diode(y, 1.6) * c
ir1: mix = 0.45; gain = 0
limit1: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.08

name: Top Boost Chime
description: AC chime: aggressive bass cut, 1.8 kHz peak (top-boost), glassy softclip, open cab.
script:
# Top Boost Chime
# AC chime: aggressive bass cut, 1.8 kHz peak (top-boost), glassy softclip, open cab.

param a = Drive [1.2, 6.5]
param b = Cut [280, 1400]
param c = Level [0.45, 1.25]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.5
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.85)
eq1: type = peak; freq = 1800; q = 1.15; gain = 4.5
stage2: y = softclip(y * 1.15, 1.5) * c
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8200; resonance = 0.32

name: Mid Boost OD
description: mid-boost OD: ~720 Hz HPF into clipper, then a real 720 Hz mid peak (not a bandpass), tone LPF.
script:
# Mid Boost OD
# mid-boost OD: ~720 Hz HPF into clipper, then a real 720 Hz mid peak (not a bandpass), tone LPF.

param a = Drive [1.2, 11.0]
param b = Tone [350, 4500]
param c = Level [0.28, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 720; resonance = 0.28
stage1: y = softclip(x, a)
eq1: type = peak; freq = 720; q = 1.65; gain = 6
stage2: y = diode(y * 1.15, 1.3) * c
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.48
ir1: mix = 0.4; gain = 6

name: Transparent Blend
description: Transparent OD: clean path blend + soft diode clip (transparent OD-style clean blend).
script:
# Transparent Blend
# Transparent OD: clean path blend + soft diode clip (transparent OD-style clean blend).

param a = Drive [0.8, 8.0]
param b = Blend [0.2, 0.95]
param c = Level [0.4, 1.3]
stage1: y = x * c
bus dirt:
 send: in = 1
 filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.3
 stage2: y = diode(x, a) * c
 eq1: type = peak; freq = 1050; q = 0.85; gain = 3.5
 filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9000; resonance = 0.3
out: main = 1-b; dirt = b

name: Filter Dist
description: RAT: soft-pre hard ceiling + steep LPF tone (classic filter-after-clip, low alias).
script:
# Filter Dist
# RAT: soft-pre hard ceiling + steep LPF tone (classic filter-after-clip, low alias).

param a = Dist [2.0, 12.0]
param b = Filter [300, 6500]
param c = Level [0.25, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.35
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a * 0.55), 0.55)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.6
stage2: y = y * c

name: Germanium Fuzz
description: Germanium fuzz: bias + soft-pre hard knee + heavy LPF + tube polish (no bare brickwall).
script:
# Germanium Fuzz
# Germanium fuzz: bias + soft-pre hard knee + heavy LPF + tube polish (no bare brickwall).

param a = Fuzz [3.0, 16.0]
param b = Tone [250, 4500]
param c = Level [0.15, 0.85]
gate1: threshold = -44; hyst = 8; hold = 0.04; range = -80
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 45; resonance = 0.3
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x + 0.06, a * 0.4), 0.38)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.7
stage2: y = tube(y, 1.4) * c
ir1: mix = 0.35; gain = 8
limit1: ceiling = -0.4; release = 0.1

name: Cyberpunk Drive
description: Guitar-shaped digital dirt: HPF, soft preamp, bitcrush, fold, short metal comb, cab LPF. Loud on purpose — not Glitch Laboratory.
script:
# Cyberpunk Drive
# Guitar-shaped digital dirt: HPF, soft preamp, bitcrush, fold, short metal comb, cab LPF. Loud on purpose — not Glitch Laboratory.

param a = Drive [1.8, 9.5]
param b = Bits [5.0, 12.0]
param c = Fold [0.22, 0.68]
param d = Metal [5, 26]
param e = Tone [1400, 7200]
param f = Level [0.85, 1.5]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 115; resonance = 0.4
stage1: y = softclip(x, a * 0.5)
eq1: type = peak; freq = 1350; q = 0.95; gain = 3.2
stage2: y = bitcrush(y, b)
stage3: y = fold(y, -c, c)
delay1: time = d; feedback = 0.34; mix = 0.16; damp = 6800
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.38
stage4: y = clamp(diode(y, 1.32), -0.7, 0.7) * f * 1.35

name: Classic Tremolo
description: Opto-style sine tremolo. Rate is a note grid (1/1..1/16), one cycle per note.
script:
# Classic Tremolo
# Opto-style sine tremolo. Rate is a note grid (1/1..1/16), one cycle per note.

param a = Rate [1/1, 1/16]
param b = Depth [0.2, 0.85]
param c = Floor [0.2, 0.7]
osc1: shape = sine; sync = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x * (c + (1.0 - c) * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)))

name: Chopper
description: Soft-square trem chopper. Rate is a note grid (1/1..1/16). Dynamics preserved (floor).
script:
# Chopper
# Soft-square trem chopper. Rate is a note grid (1/1..1/16). Dynamics preserved (floor).

param a = Rate [1/1, 1/16]
param b = Depth [0.25, 0.85]
param c = Floor [0.15, 0.55]
osc1: shape = softsquare; sync = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x * (c + (1.0 - c) * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)))

name: Optical Vibe
description: Vibe-ish: dual path AM with slow LFO and soft saturation.
script:
# Optical Vibe
# Vibe-ish: dual path AM with slow LFO and soft saturation.

param a = Rate [0.15, 6.0]
param b = Depth [0.2, 0.85]
param c = Drive [1.0, 3.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = tube(x, c)
stage2: y = y * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))

name: Chorus Delay
description: Real short delay chorus + dual-rate LFO thickness — not fake AM-only chorus.
script:
# Chorus Delay
# Real short delay chorus + dual-rate LFO thickness — not fake AM-only chorus.

param a = Rate [0.25, 3.5]
param b = Depth [0.12, 0.5]
param c = Time [8, 32]
param d = Mix [0.18, 0.55]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0
osc2: shape = sine; freq = a * 1.31; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = tube(x, 1.35)
delay1: time = c; feedback = 0.14; mix = d; damp = 9500
stage2: y = softclip(y * (1.0 - b + b * 0.5 * ((0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc2))), 1.08)

name: Low Pass Sweep
description: Musical LFO lowpass: cutoff walks Min to Min+Depth (never Min-Depth). Rate is a note grid.
script:
# Low Pass Sweep
# Musical LFO lowpass: cutoff walks Min to Min+Depth (never Min-Depth). Rate is a note grid.

param a = Rate [1/1, 1/16]
param b = Min [180, 800]
param c = Depth [400, 5000]
param d = Res [0.4, 3.0]
osc1: shape = sine; sync = a; depth = 1.0
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * c; resonance = d
stage1: y = diode(x, 1.08)

name: Bandpass Vocal
description: Formant-ish bandpass for vocal/synth body.
script:
# Bandpass Vocal
# Formant-ish bandpass for vocal/synth body.

param a = Center [350, 2800]
param b = Width [100, 1000]
param c = Drive [0.9, 2.8]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = b
stage1: y = diode(x, c)

name: Transient Bite
description: Peak envelope boosts softclip drive on attacks + mild AA LPF.
script:
# Transient Bite
# Peak envelope boosts softclip drive on attacks + mild AA LPF.

param a = Drive [1.2, 6.0]
param b = Attack [0.001, 0.015]
param c = Release [0.02, 0.2]
param d = Amount [0.25, 0.95]
env1: type = peak; attack = b; release = c
stage1: y = softclip(x * (a + env1 * a * d), 1.0)
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.28

name: Metal Gate
description: Tight metal: HPF -> tube cascade -> soft-pre hard knee -> cab LPF (filter after clip).
script:
# Metal Gate
# Tight metal: HPF -> tube cascade -> soft-pre hard knee -> cab LPF (filter after clip).

param a = Drive [4.0, 14.0]
param b = LowCut [70, 350]
param c = Level [0.2, 0.85]
param d = Width [0.0, 1.2]
gate1: threshold = -38; hyst = 8; attack = 0.004; hold = 0.08; release = 0.12; range = -80
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.5
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.45)
stage2: y = hardclip(softclip(tube(y, a * 0.5), 1.1), 0.5)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4800; resonance = 0.6
stage3: y = y * c
ir1: mix = 0.5; gain = 0
limit1: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.08
widen1: width = d

name: Vocal Grit
description: Broadcast grit: HPF, tube, air LPF.
script:
# Vocal Grit
# Broadcast grit: HPF, tube, air LPF.

param a = Drive [1.2, 5.5]
param b = LowCut [80, 280]
param c = Air [2500, 11000]
param d = Level [0.5, 1.25]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35
stage1: y = clamp(tube(x, a), -0.7, 0.7) * d
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.4

name: Radio Voice
description: AM radio bandpass + softclip + light bitcrush + LPF (quantize always filtered).
script:
# Radio Voice
# AM radio bandpass + softclip + light bitcrush + LPF (quantize always filtered).

param a = Center [500, 2200]
param b = Width [180, 900]
param c = Drive [1.2, 4.0]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = b
stage1: y = softclip(x, c)
stage2: y = bitcrush(y, 10)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 6500; resonance = 0.4

name: Vocal Comp
description: Vocal bus compressor + soft ceiling.
script:
# Vocal Comp
# Vocal bus compressor + soft ceiling.

param a = Threshold [-28.0, -8.0]
param b = Ratio [2.5, 10.0]
param c = Drive [1.0, 2.5]
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = 0.005; release = 0.12
stage1: y = diode(x, c)

name: Whisper Edge
description: Airy HPF into soft tube.
script:
# Whisper Edge
# Airy HPF into soft tube.

param a = Drive [1.1, 3.5]
param b = HPF [250, 1100]
param c = Level [0.55, 1.35]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.55
stage1: y = tube(x, a) * c

name: Doubler AM
description: Short slap double with mild AM on delay time + diode grit.
script:
# Doubler AM
# Short slap double with mild AM on delay time + diode grit.

param a = Time [12, 42]
param b = Mix [0.18, 0.55]
param c = Drive [1.0, 2.2]
param d = Rate [0.2, 4.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = d; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = diode(x, c)
delay1: time = a + osc1 * 4; feedback = 0.08; mix = b; damp = 7000
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25

name: Acid Line
description: 303-ish: env opens LPF with musical Q, then diode.
script:
# Acid Line
# 303-ish: env opens LPF with musical Q, then diode.

param a = Res [0.8, 2.6]
param b = Min [90, 500]
param c = Range [500, 4500]
param d = Drive [1.1, 4.0]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.004; release = 0.16
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b + env1 * c; resonance = a
stage1: y = diode(x, d)

name: Sidechain Pump
description: Sine ducking envelope (sidechain pump). Rate is note-grid: 1/4 at 120 BPM = 2 Hz, not milliseconds-as-Hz.
script:
# Sidechain Pump
# Sine ducking envelope (sidechain pump). Rate is note-grid: 1/4 at 120 BPM = 2 Hz, not milliseconds-as-Hz.

param a = Rate [1/1, 1/16]
param b = Depth [0.4, 1.0]
param c = Floor [0.0, 0.35]
osc1: shape = sine; sync = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x * (c + (1.0 - c) * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)))

name: Shimmer Drive
description: Tube drive into a bright high-passed hall; slow AM on the tail.
script:
# Shimmer Drive
# Tube drive into a bright high-passed hall; slow AM on the tail.

param a = Drive [1.0, 3.2]
param b = Size [0.35, 0.9]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.7]
param d = Rate [0.05, 1.2]
param e = Depth [0.12, 0.5]
param f = Damp [0.15, 0.65]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = d; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = tube(x, a)
bus shine:
  send: in = 1
  reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.78; damp = f; mix = 1; width = 0.95
  stage2: y = x * (1.0 - e + e * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))
  filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 1800; resonance = 0.25
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25
out: main = 1-c; shine = c

name: Wide Motion
description: Opposite-phase AM L/R for width.

name: Formant Crush
description: Dual formant peaks + softclip + mild LPF (clip between formants stays band-limited).
script:
# Formant Crush
# Dual formant peaks + softclip + mild LPF (clip between formants stays band-limited).

param a = F1 [320, 1100]
param b = F2 [1000, 2800]
param c = Drive [1.3, 4.5]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 220
stage1: y = clamp(softclip(x, c), -0.7, 0.7)
filter2: type = bandpass; center = b; width = 320
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9000; resonance = 0.3

name: Comb Taste
description: Metallic comb via very short delay + high feedback (true delay line, not y_prev).
script:
# Comb Taste
# Metallic comb via very short delay + high feedback (true delay line, not y_prev).

param a = Time [3, 28]
param b = Feedback [0.55, 0.9]
param c = Mix [0.25, 0.85]
param d = Drive [1.0, 2.8]
stage1: y = tube(x, d)
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = 7000
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 10000; resonance = 0.4

name: Preamp Regen Stack
description: HPF -> tube (SIMD) -> ONE y_prev regen stage -> cab LPF -> soft power (SIMD). Fast multi-stage.
script:
# Preamp Regen Stack
# HPF -> tube (SIMD) -> ONE y_prev regen stage -> cab LPF -> soft power (SIMD). Fast multi-stage.

param a = Drive [1.2, 7.0]
param b = Regen [0.08, 0.48]
param c = Tone [800, 6500]
param d = Level [0.35, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.35
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.55)
stage2: y = tube(x + y_prev * b, a * 0.4)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.45
stage3: y = softclip(y, 1.15) * d

name: Slapback Drive
description: Touch-sensitive OD into a real short delay slap (80–140 ms), damped feedback, diode polish.
script:
# Slapback Drive
# Touch-sensitive OD into a real short delay slap (80–140 ms), damped feedback, diode polish.

param a = Drive [1.0, 6.5]
param b = Time [60, 160]
param c = Mix [0.12, 0.45]
param d = Level [0.4, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.3
stage1: y = softclip(x, a * 0.75)
delay1: time = b; feedback = 0.18; mix = c; damp = 4200
stage2: y = diode(y, 1.15) * d
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 7500; resonance = 0.35

name: Cascade Loop Dirt
description: 3-stage dirt: softclip -> feedback tube (only prev stage) -> diode polish + LPF. One scalar stage.
script:
# Cascade Loop Dirt
# 3-stage dirt: softclip -> feedback tube (only prev stage) -> diode polish + LPF. One scalar stage.

param a = Drive [1.5, 9.0]
param b = Loop [0.1, 0.5]
param c = Tone [500, 6000]
param d = Level [0.3, 1.05]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 65; resonance = 0.35
stage1: y = softclip(x, a * 0.45)
stage2: y = tube(x + y_prev * b, a * 0.5)
stage3: y = diode(y, 1.35)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.5
stage4: y = softclip(y, 1.05) * d

name: Bass Regen Growl
description: Keep lows: tube pre (SIMD) + single y_prev regen blend + LPF. Low CPU, thick DI.
script:
# Bass Regen Growl
# Keep lows: tube pre (SIMD) + single y_prev regen blend + LPF. Low CPU, thick DI.

param a = Drive [1.2, 6.0]
param b = Regen [0.06, 0.4]
param c = Blend [0.2, 0.85]
param d = Level [0.5, 1.25]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 30; resonance = 0.25
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.5)
stage2: y = lerp(x, softclip(x + y_prev * b, 1.3), c) * d
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 6500; resonance = 0.35

name: Vocal Warm Loop
description: Broadcast grit with tiny regen for body. HPF -> tube -> mild y_prev softclip -> air LPF.
script:
# Vocal Warm Loop
# Broadcast grit with tiny regen for body. HPF -> tube -> mild y_prev softclip -> air LPF.

param a = Drive [1.1, 4.5]
param b = Body [0.04, 0.32]
param c = Air [3000, 12000]
param d = Level [0.55, 1.25]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.3
stage1: y = tube(x, a)
stage2: y = softclip(x + y_prev * b, 1.1)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.35
stage3: y = diode(y, 1.05) * d

name: Drum Bus Regen
description: Bus glue dirt: softclip smash -> controlled y_prev heat -> LPF. One feedback stage only.
script:
# Drum Bus Regen
# Bus glue dirt: softclip smash -> controlled y_prev heat -> LPF. One feedback stage only.

param a = Drive [1.3, 7.0]
param b = Heat [0.08, 0.45]
param c = Glue [1200, 10000]
param d = Level [0.4, 1.1]
stage1: y = softclip(x, a * 0.6)
stage2: y = hardclip(softclip(x + y_prev * b, 1.2), 0.85)
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.35
stage3: y = diode(y, 1.1) * d

name: Synth Feedback Lead
description: Lead stack: tube pre -> y_prev scream (capped) -> tone LPF -> soft ceiling. No Osc = max speed.
script:
# Synth Feedback Lead
# Lead stack: tube pre -> y_prev scream (capped) -> tone LPF -> soft ceiling. No Osc = max speed.

param a = Drive [1.5, 8.0]
param b = Feed [0.12, 0.52]
param c = Cutoff [600, 7000]
param d = Level [0.3, 1.0]
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.55)
stage2: y = tube(x + y_prev * b, a * 0.45)
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.55
stage3: y = softclip(y, 1.2) * d

name: Dual Path Regen
description: Pre softclip (SIMD) + y_prev path blended in ONE stage. Teaches: prev in a single stage only.
script:
# Dual Path Regen
# Pre softclip (SIMD) + y_prev path blended in ONE stage. Teaches: prev in a single stage only.

param a = Drive [1.2, 6.5]
param b = Regen [0.1, 0.5]
param c = Blend [0.2, 0.9]
param d = Tone [1000, 9000]
stage1: y = softclip(x, a * 0.4)
stage2: y = lerp(x, softclip(x + y_prev * b, a * 0.55), c)
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = d; resonance = 0.35

name: Tight Metal Regen
description: Tight metal: HPF -> dual tube (SIMD) -> ONE hard-knee regen -> cab LPF. High gain, still hybrid-fast.
script:
# Tight Metal Regen
# Tight metal: HPF -> dual tube (SIMD) -> ONE hard-knee regen -> cab LPF. High gain, still hybrid-fast.

param a = Gain [4.0, 14.0]
param b = Regen [0.05, 0.35]
param c = LowCut [80, 300]
param d = Level [0.2, 0.85]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.5
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.4)
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.45)
stage3: y = hardclip(softclip(x + y_prev * b, 1.15), 0.55)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4800; resonance = 0.55
stage4: y = y * d

name: Stereo Guitar Wall
description: Two amps from one mono DI: left American high-gain-style (dark, dense), right tight lead-style (tight presence). Works with a mono guitar in (silent side is copied).
script:
# Stereo Guitar Wall
# Two amps from one mono DI: left American high-gain-style (dark, dense), right tight lead-style (tight presence). Works with a mono guitar in (silent side is copied).

param a = GainL [3.5, 12.0]
param b = GainR [3.5, 12.0]
param c = Tight [55, 200]
param d = Presence [2800, 7000]
param e = Level [0.28, 0.95]
gate1: threshold = -46; hyst = 7; hold = 0.03; range = -80
split1: type = leftright {
  left {
    filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.55
    stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.5)
    stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.58)
    eq1: type = peak; freq = 780; q = 1.05; gain = 3.8
    stage3: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.5), 0.68)
    filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4500; resonance = 0.52
    stage4: y = diode(y, 1.5) * e

name: Acoustic Body

# Acoustic Body

param a = Body [120.0, 600.0]

filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 500; resonance = b

# Arp Shimmer

param a = Sparkle [4000.0, 16000.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = 2.5; depth = 1.0

stage1: y = x + osc1 * 0.03

name: Bitcrush Glitch

name: Blues Break OD

param a = Punch [1.0, 10.0]

name: Dark Atmosphere

script:
# Dark Atmosphere

param a = Dark [40.0, 300.0]
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a * 4; resonance = 1.1
stage1: y = x * 0.3 + noise(t * sr) * 0.22 + y_prev * 0.15
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = a * 12; resonance = 0.25

name: Drum Bus Glue

# Drum Bus Glue

param a = Threshold [-24.0, -6.0]
param b = Ratio [1.5, 6.0]
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = 0.003; release = 0.09
stage1: y = x * (1.0 + 0.1)

name: Harmonic Exciter

# Harmonic Exciter

name: Loudness Safe

# Loudness Safe

param a = Drive [0.5, 4.0]

filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.5

# Low End Control

stage1: y = tanh(x * 1.2)

name: Metal Scoop

# Pick Attack

stage1: y = x * (1.0 + env1 * a + 0.1)

# Pluck Bite

comp1: threshold = -18; ratio = a; attack = 0.006; release = 0.14

name: Vocal De-Ess
description: Split-band de-esser. Frequency selects the sibilance boundary; Depth lowers the upper-band threshold and increases its ratio. The vocal body remains uncompressed. Start around 5.5 kHz and set Depth by the recording.
script:
# Vocal De-Ess
# Split-band de-esser. Frequency selects the sibilance boundary; Depth lowers the upper-band threshold and increases its ratio. The vocal body remains uncompressed. Start around 5.5 kHz and set Depth by the recording.
param a = Freq [3500, 10000]
param b = Depth [0.0, 1.0]
xover1: f1 = a
bus high:
  comp1: threshold = -18 - b * 16; ratio = 1 + b * 7; attack = 0.0005; release = 0.065; knee = 6
out: low = 1; high = 1

# Vocal Double
# Subtle detune/double thickness.

param a = Detune [0.0, 0.4]
param b = DelayFb [0.0, 0.6]

stage1: y = x * (1.0 - c) + (x + y_prev * b + a * 0.05) * c

stage1: y = x * (1 - b * 0.15) + tanh(x * 1.25) * b * 0.12

filter1: type = bandpass; center = 500 + a * 1700; width = 500; resonance = c

 send: in = 1
 filter2: type = bandpass; center = 500 + a * 1700 + b; width = 500; resonance = c

  stage4: y = tube(x, a * 0.18)

out: main = 0.94; sub = e

param a = Attack [0.4, 2.4]

eq2: type = highshelf; freq = e; q = 0.7; gain = 2.8
stage3: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.08), 0.88)

stage3: y = hardclip(softclip(x * f, 1.12), 0.78)

# Offbeat Gallop
# Hard techno rumble: punchy dry kick, dotted-16th dark delay plus hall on a low bus, tube density, env-ducked so the click stays clean. Insert on the kick.

param a = Punch [0.4, 2.2]
param b = Rumble [0.25, 1.1]

description: Mixbus density: 25 Hz cut, 60 Hz boost with a 220 Hz scoop, VCA glue, 3 kHz presence, then a soft-knee ceiling. Insert on the mix.

stage1: y = tube(x, c)

name: Chaotic Stab Generator
description: Techno chaos stab: random pitch shifts -7 to +7 semitones via dual pitch blocks, resonant BP sweep 400-2400Hz LFO, fold+bitcrush 6-bit, gate, limiter.
script:
# Chaotic Stab Generator
# Techno chaos stab: random pitch shifts -7 to +7 semitones via dual pitch blocks, resonant BP sweep 400-2400Hz LFO, fold+bitcrush 6-bit, gate, limiter.

param a = Pitch Chaos [0.0, 7.0]
param b = Sweep Rate [0.5, 3.0]
param c = Reso [0.4, 1.1]
param d = Fold [0.3, 0.7]
param e = Bits [4.0, 8.0]
param f = Mix [0.6, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 65; resonance = 0.35
pitch1: shift = -a; mix = 0.22
pitch2: shift = a; mix = 0.18
osc1: shape = triangle; freq = b; depth = 1.0
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 900 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * 2400; resonance = c
stage1: y = fold(x, -d, d)
stage2: y = bitcrush(x, e)
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 7000; resonance = 0.35
comp1: threshold = -12; ratio = 4; attack = 0.005; release = 0.1; makeup = 3
limit1: ceiling = -0.4; release = 0.1
stage3: y = x * f

name: Granular Smear
description: Ambient granular texture: 6 parallel delays 25-150ms detune -4/+4 semitones, soft LFO sweep each delay time, hall reverb 0.8 decay, soft-limit -0.5dB.
script:
# Granular Smear
# Ambient granular texture: 6 parallel delays 25-150ms detune -4/+4 semitones, soft LFO sweep each delay time, hall reverb 0.8 decay, soft-limit -0.5dB.

param a = Grain Size [25.0, 150.0]
param b = Detune [0.0, 4.0]
param c = LFO Depth [0.0, 20.0]
param d = LFO Rate [0.1, 1.5]
param e = Verb Decay [0.6, 0.95]
param f = Mix [0.5, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 40; resonance = 0.28
osc1: shape = sine; freq = d; depth = 1.0
osc2: shape = triangle; freq = d * 1.3; depth = 1.0
osc3: shape = softsquare; freq = d * 0.7; depth = 1.0
pitch1: shift = -b; mix = 0.22
pitch2: shift = b; mix = 0.22
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8000; resonance = 0.3
reverb1: size = 0.85; decay = e; damp = 0.35; mix = 0.35
limit1: ceiling = -0.5; release = 0.15
stage1: y = x * (0.75 + 0.45 * f)
bus g1:
  send: in = 1
  delay1: time = max(8, a * 0.7 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * c); feedback = 0.25; mix = 1; damp = 7000
bus g2:
  send: in = 1
  delay2: time = max(8, a * 1.1 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc2) * c); feedback = 0.28; mix = 1; damp = 7000
bus g3:
  send: in = 1
  delay3: time = max(8, a * 0.9 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc3) * c); feedback = 0.22; mix = 1; damp = 7000
out: main = 1; g1 = 0.32; g2 = 0.3; g3 = 0.28

name: Blastbeat Front Edge
description: Fast/slow envelope contrast emphasizes stick attack while the Sustain control reduces the space between hits. Short detector recovery suits blastbeats; set Gate for the actual recording. Insert on close drums, not cymbal overheads.
script:
# Blastbeat Front Edge
# Fast/slow envelope contrast emphasizes stick attack while the Sustain control reduces the space between hits. Short detector recovery suits blastbeats; set Gate for the actual recording. Insert on close drums, not cymbal overheads.
param a = Attack [0, 3]
param b = Sustain [0, 0.75]
param c = Gate [-65, -25]
param d = Level [0.4, 1.2]
gate1: threshold = c; attack = 0.0003; hold = 0.008; release = 0.035; range = -36
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.0002; release = 0.012
env2: type = rms; attack = 0.018; release = 0.055
stage1: y = x * clamp(1 + a * max(0, env1 - env2) / (env1 + 0.04) - b * env2 / (env1 + 0.04), 0.3, 3)
eq1: type = peak; freq = 3400; q = 0.8; gain = 2
stage2: y = tanh(x * 1.8) * d
limit1: ceiling = -1; release = 0.025

name: Snare Steel Crack
description: Parallel high-mid saturation adds a metallic crack without distorting the entire drum body. Crack controls the parallel amount; Snap sets its upper bite. Keep the return below the dry snare on dense blastbeats.
script:
# Snare Steel Crack
# Parallel high-mid saturation adds a metallic crack without distorting the entire drum body. Crack controls the parallel amount; Snap sets its upper bite. Keep the return below the dry snare on dense blastbeats.
param a = Crack [0, 0.65]
param b = Drive [3, 18]
param c = Snap [1800, 6500]
stage1: y = x
bus crack:
 send: in = 1
 filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 700; resonance = 0.707
 eq1: type = peak; freq = c; q = 1.1; gain = 6
 stage2: y = tanh(x * b) * 0.55
 filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8500; resonance = 0.707
 comp1: threshold = -18; ratio = 6; attack = 0.008; release = 0.045; makeup = 2
out: main = 1; crack = a

name: Growl Iron Throat
description: Parallel chest and formant grit for recorded growls. The dry voice remains intelligible; the distorted band avoids subsonic breath noise and high-frequency fizz. Adjust Gate before increasing Rage.
script:
# Growl Iron Throat
# Parallel chest and formant grit for recorded growls. The dry voice remains intelligible; the distorted band avoids subsonic breath noise and high-frequency fizz. Adjust Gate before increasing Rage.
param a = Rage [4, 28]
param b = Throat [450, 1500]
param c = Grind [0, 0.85]
param d = Gate [-65, -25]
gate1: threshold = d; attack = 0.001; hold = 0.04; release = 0.07; range = -30
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 65; resonance = 0.707
comp1: threshold = -22; ratio = 4; attack = 0.008; release = 0.09; knee = 5; makeup = 3
bus throat:
 send: main = 1
 filter2: type = highpass; cutoff = 190; resonance = 0.707
 eq1: type = peak; freq = b; q = 1.4; gain = 7
 stage1: y = tanh(x * a) * 0.48
 filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4800; resonance = 0.707
out: main = 1 - c * 0.3; throat = c

name: Deathwall Tight Stack
description: High-gain DI rhythm amp: tight pre-distortion bass, two saturation stages, focused pick mids and a full cabinet IR. Gate tracks palm-mute gaps; Tone controls post-cab fizz. Start from a clean guitar DI.
script:
# Deathwall Tight Stack
# High-gain DI rhythm amp: tight pre-distortion bass, two saturation stages, focused pick mids and a full cabinet IR. Gate tracks palm-mute gaps; Tone controls post-cab fizz. Start from a clean guitar DI.
param a = Gain [6, 32]
param b = Tight [65, 180]
param c = Bite [0, 8]
param d = Tone [3500, 9000]
param e = Gate [-65, -25]
param f = Level [0.25, 1]
gate1: threshold = e; attack = 0.0004; hold = 0.012; release = 0.035; range = -72
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.707
eq1: type = peak; freq = 1200; q = 0.85; gain = 5
stage1: y = tanh(x * a) * 0.65
filter2: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.707
eq2: type = peak; freq = 3100; q = 0.9; gain = c
stage2: y = tanh(x * 4.5) * 0.8
ir1: mix = 1; gain = 0
eq3: type = peak; freq = 350; q = 1.2; gain = -3
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = d; resonance = 0.707
stage3: y = x * f
limit1: ceiling = -1; release = 0.06

name: Baritone Serrated Stack
description: A raspier baritone DI amp with asymmetric diode saturation, lean low mids and a British cabinet. Distinct from the tight rhythm stack: stronger upper harmonics and a coarse edge. Increase Body only after tuning the gate.
script:
# Baritone Serrated Stack
# A raspier baritone DI amp with asymmetric diode saturation, lean low mids and a British cabinet. Distinct from the tight rhythm stack: stronger upper harmonics and a coarse edge. Increase Body only after tuning the gate.
param a = Gain [5, 24]
param b = Body [-6, 5]
param c = Edge [1500, 4500]
param d = Gate [-65, -25]
param e = Level [0.25, 1.1]
gate1: threshold = d; attack = 0.0005; hold = 0.02; release = 0.045; range = -66
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 78; resonance = 0.707
stage1: y = clamp(diode(x * a, 1.6), -0.7, 0.7)
filter2: type = highpass; cutoff = 35; resonance = 0.707
eq1: type = peak; freq = 260; q = 0.8; gain = b
eq2: type = peak; freq = c; q = 1.25; gain = 5
stage2: y = tanh(x * 3) * 0.8
ir1: mix = 1; gain = 0
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 7200; resonance = 0.707
stage3: y = x * e
limit1: ceiling = -1; release = 0.06

name: Ironclad Split Bass
description: Clean compressed fundamentals below the crossover, aggressive cabinet-filtered mids above it. Grind drives only the upper band, keeping the bass weight distinct from guitar distortion. Crossover changes the clean/dirty boundary.
script:
# Ironclad Split Bass
# Clean compressed fundamentals below the crossover, aggressive cabinet-filtered mids above it. Grind drives only the upper band, keeping the bass weight distinct from guitar distortion. Crossover changes the clean/dirty boundary.
param a = Grind [3, 25]
param b = Crossover [100, 280]
param c = Clank [0, 7]
param d = Body [0.7, 1.3]
param e = Dirt [0.2, 1]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 28; resonance = 0.707
xover1: f1 = b
bus low:
 comp1: threshold = -22; ratio = 3; attack = 0.018; release = 0.12; knee = 6; makeup = 2
 stage1: y = x * d
bus high:
 eq1: type = peak; freq = 1800; q = 0.9; gain = c
 stage2: y = tanh(x * a) * 0.65
 ir1: mix = 1; gain = 0
 filter2: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.707
out: low = 1; high = e

name: Forge Kick Overdrive
description: Focused hard-techno kick distortion with a protected low band and a dense, biting upper body. Impact boosts the attack before saturation; Weight balances the clean fundamental. Tune the crossover to the kick.
script:
# Forge Kick Overdrive
# Focused hard-techno kick distortion with a protected low band and a dense, biting upper body. Impact boosts the attack before saturation; Weight balances the clean fundamental. Tune the crossover to the kick.
param a = Drive [4, 30]
param b = Split [65, 160]
param c = Impact [0, 2]
param d = Weight [0.65, 1.3]
param e = Bite [0.2, 1]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 25; resonance = 0.707
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.0003; release = 0.018
env2: type = peak; attack = 0.018; release = 0.08
stage1: y = x * (1 + c * max(0, env1 - env2) / (env1 + 0.04))
xover1: f1 = b
bus low:
 stage2: y = tanh(x * 1.4) * d * 0.85
bus high:
 eq1: type = peak; freq = 1600; q = 0.9; gain = 4
 stage3: y = tanh(x * a) * 0.6
 filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8500; resonance = 0.707
out: low = 1; high = e

name: Concrete Kick Fracture
description: Full-band wavefolding creates a crushed, tearing kick body. A dry parallel path preserves the first hit; the wet path has its own DC and fizz filters. More Fold deliberately changes pitch and timbre, so check against the bass line.
script:
# Concrete Kick Fracture
# Full-band wavefolding creates a crushed, tearing kick body. A dry parallel path preserves the first hit; the wet path has its own DC and fizz filters. More Fold deliberately changes pitch and timbre, so check against the bass line.
param a = Fold [2, 14]
param b = Damage [0, 0.85]
param c = Tone [2200, 8500]
stage1: y = x
bus fracture:
 send: in = 1
 filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 32; resonance = 0.707
 stage2: y = sin(x * a) * 0.62
 stage3: y = tanh(x * 3.5) * 0.7
 filter2: type = highpass; cutoff = 30; resonance = 0.707
 filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.707
out: main = 1 - b * 0.65; fracture = b

name: Schranz Percussion Furnace
description: Dense upper-band percussion grind with the sub band retained. Slow compressor attack keeps the front edge; short release brings up the abrasive sustain. Best on percussion loops and drum buses, with a separate kick/sub balance.
script:
# Schranz Percussion Furnace
# Dense upper-band percussion grind with the sub band retained. Slow compressor attack keeps the front edge; short release brings up the abrasive sustain. Best on percussion loops and drum buses, with a separate kick/sub balance.
param a = Heat [3, 22]
param b = Split [100, 400]
param c = Crush [8, 24]
param d = Air [3500, 11000]
xover1: f1 = b
bus high:
 comp1: threshold = -c; ratio = 8; attack = 0.012; release = 0.045; knee = 2; makeup = 5
 stage1: y = tanh(x * a) * 0.58
 filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = d; resonance = 0.707
out: low = 1; high = 0.85

name: Industrial Bass Excision
description: A clean sub underneath a moving, folded mid band. Motion changes the distortion emphasis rather than modulating the sub level. Mono input remains mono; use stereo source material when width is wanted.
script:
# Industrial Bass Excision
# A clean sub underneath a moving, folded mid band. Motion changes the distortion emphasis rather than modulating the sub level. Mono input remains mono; use stereo source material when width is wanted.
param a = Drive [2, 16]
param b = Motion [0, 1]
param c = Rate [0.1, 4]
param d = Split [70, 180]
param e = Grind [0.2, 1]
osc1: shape = triangle; freq = c; depth = 1
xover1: f1 = d
bus high:
 filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 120; resonance = 0.707
 eq1: type = peak; freq = 900 + osc1 * b * 500; q = 1.4; gain = 6
 stage1: y = sin(x * a) * 0.6
 stage2: y = tanh(x * 2.5) * 0.65
 filter2: type = highpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.707
 filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 5200; resonance = 0.707
out: low = 1; high = e

name: Motion Blur Rumble Send
description: Wet-only rumble return: diffused reverb, slow moving low-mid emphasis, saturation and input-envelope ducking. Send a kick into it and keep the original kick on its own track. Floor removes unusable sub energy; Return controls the tail level.
script:
# Motion Blur Rumble Send
# Wet-only rumble return: diffused reverb, slow moving low-mid emphasis, saturation and input-envelope ducking. Send a kick into it and keep the original kick on its own track. Floor removes unusable sub energy; Return controls the tail level.
param a = Blur [0.3, 0.9]
param b = Motion [0, 1]
param c = Drive [1, 9]
param d = Duck [0, 0.95]
param e = Floor [25, 65]
param f = Return [0.4, 1.5]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.0003; release = 0.16
osc1: shape = sine; freq = 0.23; depth = 1
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.707
reverb1: size = a; decay = 0.75; damp = 0.85; mix = 1; width = 0.8
eq1: type = peak; freq = 180 + osc1 * b * 85; q = 1.2; gain = 5
stage1: y = tanh(x * c) * 0.75
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 420; resonance = 0.707
filter3: type = highpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.707
ms1: mode = encode
filter4: channel = side; type = highpass; cutoff = 160; resonance = 0.707
ms2: mode = decode
stage2: y = x * (1 - d * clamp(env1 * 4, 0, 1)) * f

name: Gated Rumble Machine Send
description: Rhythmic wet-only rumble with tempo-locked tremolo and optional external kick ducking. Use on an aux return. With no external sidechain the compressor remains open; rhythmic motion continues from the internal oscillator.
script:
# Gated Rumble Machine Send
# Rhythmic wet-only rumble with tempo-locked tremolo and optional external kick ducking. Use on an aux return. With no external sidechain the compressor remains open; rhythmic motion continues from the internal oscillator.
param a = Drive [2, 12]
param b = Gate [0, 1]
param c = Tail [0.25, 0.8]
param d = Duck [0, 12]
osc1: shape = triangle; sync = 1/8; depth = 1
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 30; resonance = 0.707
reverb1: size = c; decay = 0.65; damp = 0.9; mix = 1; width = 0.5
stage1: y = tanh(x * a) * 0.7 * (1 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 280; resonance = 0.707
comp1: source = sidechain; threshold = -24; ratio = 1 + d; attack = 0.001; release = 0.14; knee = 6

name: Sub Harmonic Translation
description: Adds filtered upper harmonics derived from the existing bass, helping it remain audible on small speakers. The original fundamental stays on the dry path. Amount controls perceived bass presence; this does not synthesize a lower octave.
script:
# Sub Harmonic Translation
# Adds filtered upper harmonics derived from the existing bass, helping it remain audible on small speakers. The original fundamental stays on the dry path. Amount controls perceived bass presence; this does not synthesize a lower octave.
param a = Focus [55, 140]
param b = Drive [2, 12]
param c = Amount [0, 0.65]
stage1: y = x
bus harmonics:
 send: in = 1
 filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.707
 stage2: y = tanh(x * b) * 0.5
 filter2: type = highpass; cutoff = a * 1.5; resonance = 0.707
 filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 650; resonance = 0.707
out: main = 1; harmonics = c

name: Drum Crush Parallel
description: A dedicated parallel drum compressor with high-pass cleanup on the crushed path. Attack leaves the dry transient intact and Density blends in sustain. Match perceived level before judging the result.
script:
# Drum Crush Parallel
# A dedicated parallel drum compressor with high-pass cleanup on the crushed path. Attack leaves the dry transient intact and Density blends in sustain. Match perceived level before judging the result.
param a = Density [0, 0.65]
param b = Threshold [14, 36]
param c = Recovery [0.035, 0.2]
stage1: y = x
bus crush:
 send: in = 1
 filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 85; resonance = 0.707
 comp1: threshold = -b; ratio = 10; attack = 0.018; release = c; knee = 4; makeup = 7
 stage2: y = tanh(x * 1.2) * 0.8
out: main = 1 - a * 0.25; crush = a

name: Low Mid Congestion Control
description: Three-band compression focused on the low mids. Low and high bands retain the phase-matched crossover response; only the congested middle band is reduced. Tune the boundaries to the source and reduce Amount when the mix loses body.
script:
# Low Mid Congestion Control
# Three-band compression focused on the low mids. Low and high bands retain the phase-matched crossover response; only the congested middle band is reduced. Tune the boundaries to the source and reduce Amount when the mix loses body.
param a = Low [100, 250]
param b = High [450, 1200]
param c = Amount [0, 1]
xover1: f1 = a; f2 = b
bus mid:
 comp1: threshold = -16 - c * 16; ratio = 1 + c * 3; attack = 0.03; release = 0.16; knee = 9
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1

name: Master Transient Glue
description: Gentle slow-attack bus compression with an adjustable threshold and recovery. Intended for modest gain reduction while preserving attacks; no automatic loudness maximization. Match bypass loudness and leave delivery loudness to the final mastering stage.
script:
# Master Transient Glue
# Gentle slow-attack bus compression with an adjustable threshold and recovery. Intended for modest gain reduction while preserving attacks; no automatic loudness maximization. Match bypass loudness and leave delivery loudness to the final mastering stage.
param a = Threshold [8, 26]
param b = Ratio [1, 2]
param c = Recovery [0.08, 0.4]
param d = Makeup [0, 3]
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = b; attack = 0.03; release = c; knee = 9; makeup = d
limit1: ceiling = -1; release = 0.12

name: Master Side Low Cleanup
description: High-pass filtering only the side channel removes unstable stereo sub energy while retaining the center bass. The side high shelf can soften wide cymbals. Not a loudness enhancer; compare stereo image and mono translation.
script:
# Master Side Low Cleanup
# High-pass filtering only the side channel removes unstable stereo sub energy while retaining the center bass. The side high shelf can soften wide cymbals. Not a loudness enhancer; compare stereo image and mono translation.
param a = Mono Below [35, 180]
param b = Side Air [-3, 1]
ms1: mode = encode
filter1: channel = side; type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.707
eq1: channel = side; type = highshelf; freq = 6500; q = 0.707; gain = b
ms2: mode = decode
